1.name: Awaken
1.description: Awakens all sleeping members of the party.

2.name: Pandora's box
2.description: Opens a dimensional rift and randomly pulls an entity into your reality. Can be cast 3 times a day.
2.explanation:
Can be cast 3 times per game day (the count starts again at midnight) and not in towns. Chances:
30%: receive 1-100 gold
30%: receive a random L1 item
20%: random L1 monster appears
5%: receive 101 - 200 gold
5%: receive a random L2 item
5%: random L2 monster appears
4%: receive 1000 - 10000 gold
1%: Dragon Lord (ID 83) appears

3.name: Elemental Arrow
3.description: Does 8 damage of a random elemental type to one monster.

4.name: First Aid
4.description: Heals one character for 6 hit points.

5.name: Flying Fist
5.description: Does 6-10 physical damage to one monster.

6.name: Light
6.description: Lights up dark dungeons and caves.

7.name: Cure Wounds
7.description: Heals one character for 15 hit points.

8.name: Energy Blast
8.description: Does 2-6 magical damage per caster level to one monster. Costs 2 mana per caster level (rounded up).

9.name: Revitalize
9.description: Removes the "Weak" status from one character.

10.name: Sparks
10.description: Does 2-3 magic damage per caster level to all monsters in a straight line. Costs 1.5 mana per caster level (rounded up).

11.name: Suppress Poison
11.description: Doubles the time left until one character dies of poison. Holds until the character is cured.
11.explanation: The timer of the condition is set back, the condition itself stays until it is cured.

12.name: Pain
12.description: Does 2-6 physical damage per caster level to all beasts and humanoids in a straight line. Costs 2 mana per caster level (rounded up).
12.explanation: Hits every monster of the groups beast, humanoid and monster_humanoid on the line through the target; other monsters on the line are passed over. Cast at another kind of monster it is refused and costs nothing.

13.name: Dimensional Phasing
13.description: Put all monsters in a 4 field radius in a different dimensional phase for 5 turns. Each monster can only be shifted once. Robots cannot be shifted.
13.explanation:
1) Stops all movement/animation for the monsters in the radius
2) Colors them purple and makes them half transparent
3) They do not move or attack and cannot be attacked or take damage of any kind
4) After 5 turns they return to normal
5) Each monster can only be shifted once, robots never

14.name: Toxic Cloud
14.description: Poisons all monsters in a 5 field radius for 3 turns. Each turn the poison does 10 acid damage.
14.explanation: A massive green cloud rises round the party and reaches every monster within 5 fields, also those that are not visible (through walls). Each cast puts one dose of poison on every monster: a dose does 10 acid damage (reduced by the acid resistance) at the end of each of the next 3 monster turns. Doses stack when the spell is cast again, each lasts exactly 3 turns. While a monster is poisoned, a green cloud rises from its feet to its top. Monsters in another dimension take no poison damage until they return.

15.name: Acid Stream
15.description: Does 25 acid damage to all monsters in a row.

16.name: Jump
16.description: Moves the party two spaces ahead

17.name: Protection from Elements
17.description: Gives the party damage reduction to either fire, cold, magic or acid. Costs 1 mana per caster level (rounded up).
17.explanation: Every hit of the chosen element is reduced by the caster's level in points for 8 hours.

18.name: Suppress Madness
18.description: Doubles the time left until one character dies of madness. Holds until the character is cured.
18.explanation: The timer of the condition is set back, the condition itself stays until it is cured.

19.name: Turn Undead
19.description: Does 100 damage to one undead monster. Nothing reduces it.
19.explanation: Works only on the monster in front of the party and only on undead (nothing is spent on a living target).

20.name: Stone Skin
20.description: Gives a character +1 AC per caster's level, but halves the target's speed for 12h. Costs 1 mana per caster level (rounded up).

21.name: Levitate
21.description: Lets the party levitate to avoid pit traps for 4 hours

22.name: Gravity
22.description: Pulls all monsters in a 4 field radius around the party, if there is a way.

23.name: Suppress Disease
23.description: Doubles the time left until one character dies of disease. Holds until the character is cured.
23.explanation: The timer of the condition is set back, the condition itself stays until it is cured.

24.name: Wizard's Eye
24.description: Displays a map of the party's surroundings for 8h
24.explanation:
1) Shows the level incl. The not explored areas
2) Shows traps, if crow is mascot
3) Does not show monsters (see "36 - Detect monster")

25.name: Rage
25.description: Gives a character +1 damage per caster's level, but halves the target's armor for 12h. Costs 1 mana per caster level (rounded up).

26.name: Identify Monster
26.description: Shows the hit points, AC, attacks per round, and special abilities of monsters in combat range.

27.name: Nature's Cure
27.description: Heals one character for 25 hit points.

28.name: Power Cure
28.description: Heals one character for 2-12 hit points per caster level. Costs 2 mana per caster level (rounded up).

29.name: Frost Bite
29.description: Deals 35 cold damage to one monster.

30.name: Dimensional Rift
30.description: Target Character cannot attack or be attacked for 5 turns. If party moves the spell is cancelled.
30.explanation:
1) Works similar like 13- Dimensional phasing, but on own character
2) color character in purple
3) Character does not receive any damage, nor does he have a turn
4) End spell after 5 turns or if party moves a field

31.name: Immobilize
31.description: Makes a monster unable to move for 3 turns. Each monster can only be immobilized once.
31.explanation:
1) The monster in front of the party cannot move.
2) It receives damage as usual and can attack, if party is in front of it or if it has range capabilties

32.name: Lloyd's Beacon
32.explanation:
1) When cast the player selects between "Set" and "Return"
2) "Set" remembers the current position (for this caster)
3) "Return" moves the party back to the position
4) Spell is cross-world (e.g. save a position in town and return to it from a dungeon)

33.name: Power Shield
33.description: Reduces incoming damage for the party by 10% for 1h.
33.explanation: Will show a power shield icon in the top right. Use a dummy until final icon is provided

34.name: Walk on Water
34.description: Allows the party to walk on water for 4h

36.name: Detect Monster
36.description: Shows monsters on mini map for 8h
36.explanation: Shows monsters on mini map (does not reveal anything unexplored - this is done via 24-wizard's eye)

37.name: Summon Snakes
37.description: Does 4-6 acid damage per caster level to all monsters in a straight line. Costs 5 mana per caster level (rounded up).
37.explanation: Penetrating: hits every monster on the line through the target. Uses the new button. When cast, a coil of snakes (model Snakes) appears on the floor in front of every monster that is hit, to the left of it, with the heads turned towards the monster. The model is loaded with the game. It fades in within 0.3 s, stays for 0.5 s and fades to transparent within 0.5 s.

38.name: Acid Spray
38.description: Does 15 acid damage to all monsters in view of the party and lowers target's armor.
38.explanation: Hits all monsters the party sees ahead (its field of view; green lines of light, no target needed; the lines throw off acid bubbles and poison green clouds along their first two fields). Every hit takes away 10% of the monster's original armor, the armor cannot drop below 0. The loss stays until the monster dies and counts for blows and arrows (Identify Monster shows what is left).

39.name: Cold Ray
39.description: Does 2-4 cold damage per caster level to all monsters in a straight line. Costs 3 mana per caster level (rounded up).
39.explanation: Penetrating: hits every monster on the line through the target. A light blue line of light (no projectile); like every ray it throws off particles along its way, many close to the party and fewer further out, none beyond two fields: light blue ice crystals and small white clouds.

41.name: Clumsy
41.description: Makes the monster in front of you clumsy, thus lowering its chance to hit you.
41.explanation:
1) Monster in front of the player rolls a dice when attacking.
2) it has a 25% chance that the attack does not take place. Otherwise continue with the standard process for attacks
3) Effect does not stack and stays with the monster until it dies

42.name: Time Distortion
42.explanation: Finds the closest area to party's current location, where they are out of reach of monster attacks

43.name: Finger of Death
43.description: 50% chance to kill a low level monster instantly, which is next to you.
43.explanation:
1) Only works on monsters adjacent to the party and only monsters the party is looking at
2) 50% chance that a L1/L2 monster is killed instantly (L1/L2 refers to the monsters treasure level)

44.name: Fireball
44.description: Does 3-7 fire damage per caster level to the target and all monsters next to it. Costs 5 mana per caster level (rounded up).
44.explanation: Hits the monster in front of the party and all monsters next to it (also diagonally). The party is never hit.

45.name: Nature's Gate
45.description: Teleports the party to another biome. Works only outside.
45.explanation:
1) selects a random biome (explored or unexplored), different from the current one
2) places the party in a place, where no monsters are in attack range
3) party must only be placed on freely accessible areas

46.name: Communion
46.description: 50% chance to remove curses from a character

47.name: Teleport
47.description: Moves party up to nine spaces.

49.name: Deadly Swarm
49.description: Does 40 physical damage to all monsters in a straight line.
49.explanation: Penetrating: hits every monster in the straight line in front of the party. When cast, ten insects (model Insect, loaded with the game) fly round the first monster in front of the party on natural, swarm-like paths. If more monsters stand on the line, five more fly round the second monster (10 + 5) and no further swarm is shown (the others are hit all the same). The swarm stays for 2 s and fades to transparent within 0.5 s.

50.name: Dragon Breath
50.description: Hits all monsters for 5 damage per caster level. Costs 7 mana per caster level (rounded up).

51.name: Fiery Flail
51.description: Does 100 fire damage to one monster.

52.name: Super Shelter
52.description: Lets party rest in unsafe areas.
52.explanation:
1) Party can rest, even if monsters are nearby
2) Monsters do not attack party during the rest

53.name: Fantastic Freeze
53.description: Does 40 cold damage to all monsters in a 2-field radius.
53.explanation: Hits every monster in the 5 x 5 field round the party (the party stands in the middle; no wall stops it, like Toxic Cloud). No projectile: massive light blue cloud particles well up at the party and drift outwards, frost strikes every monster that is hit.

54.name: Sanity
54.description: Removes the crazy status from a character.

55.name: Combine
55.description: Combine 3 items of the same type to the next higher material level.
55.explanation:
1) after casting, player must select a character
2) Characters inventory is opened
3) If character does not have 3 items of the same kind and material (e.g. 3 wooden short swords) the spell is cancelled (mana is still consumed)
4) if at least one valid combination is found, player selects the 3 valid items and clicks a "Combine" button (button is only active, if combination is correct). Put an "Abort" button next to combine
5) On successful combine replace the 3 items with 1 item of the same type, but 1 material level better. If combining rings, the ring will be 1 level better as well

56.name: Half For Me
56.description: Heals one character, but damages the caster for half the hit points healed
56.explanation: 1) Heals target character to the maximum or to the extend that caster has 1 HP left (e.g. target character missed 30HP, character has 11 HP> max 10HP can be taken from caster, meaning the target is healed by 20 HP)

57.name: Emergency rations
57.description: Creates enough food for the party to rest.
57.explanation: Creates 1 food for the party, but cannot exceed 1 food.

58.name: Duplication
58.description: Sacrifice 10'000 gold for a 50% chance to duplicate an item. There is a 25% chance that the item is destroyed.
58.explanation: The gold is lost in every case. 50%: the item is duplicated (nothing happens if no backpack has room), 25%: the item is destroyed, 25%: nothing happens.

59.name: Disintegrate
59.description: Does 250 magic damage to one monster.

60.name: Moon Ray
60.description: Does 100 magic damage to all monsters in a line and heals the party
60.explanation: Heals each party member by up to 50 HP. No projectile: a thick white and violet ray runs from the party through every monster on the line; its particles (violet sparks, wisps, glints and crescents) lie along the first two fields.

61.name: Stone to Flesh
61.description: Removes the "Petrified" status from one character

62.name: Etherealise
62.description: Allows party to walk through a door or wall.
62.explanation: The party moves two fields ahead through the door or wall; the field beyond must be free.

63.name: Dancing Sword
63.description: Does 6-14 physical damage per caster level to all monsters in view. Costs 7.5 mana per caster level (rounded up).
63.explanation: Hits all monsters currently in the party's field of view (a blade flies to each of them, no target needed). Mana 15 (7.5 per caster level).

64.name: Mass Distortion
64.description: 20% chance to damage a group of monsters in view
64.explanation:
1) Every monster in view of the party (as for Prismatic Light) rolls a dice individually, no target needed
2) with a 20% chance it loses 50% of its health
3) Does not work on L5 monsters
The monsters that are hit flash violet.

66.name: Town Portal
66.description: Teleports party to any visited town. Can only be used outside battle.
66.explanation: Functions like a regular town portal.

67.name: Transform Ring
67.description: Randomly changes a ring to another one of the same level, with a 25% risk of the ring being destroyed.

68.name: Mega Volts
68.description: Does 200 magical damage to all monsters in a straight line.
68.explanation: Penetrating: hits every monster on the line through the target.

69.name: Holy Word
69.description: Severely damages or destroys undead monster
69.explanation:
1) Hits every undead monster on the line through the target and directly reduces its HP by 150
2) Undead monsters with max HP > 600 instantly lose 25% of their max HP instead

70.name: Resurrect
70.description: Revives a rotten character with 1 hit point, but permanently reduces their Endurance by 1 and caster magically ages by 5 years.

71.name: Sun Ray
71.description: Does 200 fire damage to one monster.
71.explanation: No projectile: a thick, glowing orange ray runs from the party to the monster; its particles (grey smoke puffs and flame clouds) lie along the first two fields.

72.name: Meteor Shower
72.description: Does 100 fire damage to all monsters the party could see in every direction. Works only outside.
72.explanation: Hits every monster the party could see turning on the spot (no wall in the way), within the action radius. Where a meteor lands, big grey clouds of dust billow up and brown splinters of earth fly out and fall back.

73.name: Prismatic Light
73.description: Does 90-110 random damage effect to all monsters in view of the party.
73.explanation: Hits all monsters in the party's field of view; a beam in the color of the damage type goes to each.

74.name: Incinerate
74.description: Does 250-500 fire damage to one monster

75.name: Elemental Storm
75.description: Does 150 fire, ice or acid damage to all monsters the party could see in every direction.
75.explanation: Hits every monster the party could see turning on the spot (no wall in the way), within the action radius; each gets one of the three elements at random.

76.name: Star Burst
76.description: Does 200 magical damage to all monsters in a 3 field radius around the party.
76.explanation: The damage is magic, the picture is fire: a ball of flames flies out of the party in every direction (within the 3 field radius) and fire strikes every monster that is hit.

77.name: Implosion
77.description: Does 1000 magical damage to one monster

78.name: Divine Intervention
78.description: All party members are cured of all statuses (except "Eradicated") and restored to full hit points, but the caster ages 5 years.
